repos.description: The project's repositories. The first is its home: entry chain, frontier and consent record live there. The file name is the project ID.

path.description: Subdirectory, when the repo holds more than one project.

ref.description: Branch to read. Default: the repo's default branch (HEAD).

role.description: What this repo is for, in plain words, when there are several.

contact.description: GitHub handle of the maintainer who requested listing.

overlay.description: A manifest used only while the repo has no discover.json of its own. Same shape as discover.json.

frontier_adapter.description: Maps a pre-v0 frontier record onto v0 fields: {v0_field: raw_field}, plus metric {name, value, decimal, direction} and evidence_level (declared).

process_changed_on.description: As in the manifest, for repos listed through an adapter.

assessment.description: Path of the latest assessment record, e.g. assessments/<id>/<date>-<assessor>.md.

consent.description: What the hub last verified from the project's consent record (spec §11.4).

source.description: Path of the record, or 'application' for consent by submitting or approving the registry PR.
